facts.intervention: Conventional and digital occlusal analysis methods (articulating paper, shimstock, T-Scan, OccluSense, Accura, intraoral scanners, virtual articulators, jaw tracking)
facts.main_result: Conventional methods are simple but subjective and cannot quantify occlusal force; digital systems give objective contact, force, timing and movement data but are limited by cost and training.
facts.funding_coi: No specific funding; no conflicts of interest
facts.limitations: Digital use may be limited by cost, technical requirements and operator training.
